root_cause.text: The function `ice_set_ringparam()` nullified the `tstamp_ring` pointer of temporary transmit rings without clearing the corresponding `ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME` flag, causing a NULL pointer dereference in the error cleanup path when `ice_setup_tx_ring()` fails and the flag remains set.
root_cause.evidence: The commit description explicitly states: "ice_set_ringparam nullifies tstamp_ring of temporary tx_rings, without clearing ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME bit. When ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME is set and the subsequent ice_setup_tx_ring() call fails, a NULL pointer dereference could happen..." The patch adds `clear_bit(ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME, tx_rings[i].flags);` to resolve this mismatch.

intent_record.intent_summary: Clear the TX TIME flag on transmit rings when reinitializing them during ring parameter changes to prevent stale flag state from affecting the new ring configuration.
intent_record.what: Added a call to clear_bit(ICE_TX_RING_FLAGS_TXTIME, tx_rings[i].flags) inside the loop that initializes transmit rings in ice_set_ringparam.
intent_record.how: Clears the TX TIME flag on each transmit ring before setting up the ring, ensuring that any previously set flag from an old configuration is removed, preventing unintended TX time scheduling behavior.
